text:
jamie: quick idea 12: lightweight incident checkpoints? mandatory check-ins at 2h, 24h, 72h, 1w after any P1. keeps followups visible so tickets don't disappear.

sarah: +1. we've seen regressions because people assumed someone else would own the 72h check. a pasteable template would help.

rahul: i like it but keep it tight. ops is overloaded. propose checklist fields only: current mitigations, remediation owner, blockers, rollback risk. no essays.

maria: add a recurrence signal line: "recurrence check" (alert history last 90d, recent deploys). if recurrence_count > 2 escalate to patterns board.

ben: also pick one tracking place. i vote for a dedicated kanban column called "Incident Checkpoints" on the incident board. owner moves card and posts a short thread update.

jamie: agreed on single source. also thinking rotation tweaks: incident commander rotation weekly but shadow for first 2 rotations to make handoffs smoother. shadow signs off on checkpoint checklist.

rahul: can we automate reminders? oncall-bot could DM owners at each checkpoint and post a short summary to the thread to reduce manual nudges.

oncall-bot: automated reminder placeholder: owner @placeholder will receive DM at 2h, 24h, 72h, 1w for thread 1950123456. (automation PR needed) :robot_face: 

maria: prototype template (paste into postmortems):
```
Checkpoint: <2h | 24h | 72h | 1w>
Owner: @<name>
Status: (Mitigating / Investigating / Remediated / Monitoring)
Next steps: short bullets with owners + ETAs
Recurrence check: last 90d incidents linked, recent deploys
Blockers: short list + who can unblock
Incident board card: <link>
```

ben: i'll take care of the board change. can someone open the automation PR for the bot reminders and the tiny RFC for the template?

jamie: i'll write the RFC today. proposal: pilot with 4 teams for 8 weeks, measure change in "stale action rate" and number of recurrence escalations caught.

rahul: suggested metrics: percent of actions without owners after 72h, median time-to-remediation, recurrence rate within 30d after remediation. add these to ops dashboard.

maria: if pilot looks good, add a closure gate: postmortem can't be marked closed until 72h checkpoint exists and at least one followup action has an owner.

jamie: that closure gate seems sensible. i'll draft RFC and tag reviewers (sre, infra, platform). thanks all. :thumbsup:

sarah: thanks — super actionable. small ask: include a short template for the IC handoff when rotation hits mid-incident.

jamie: good call. adding an "IC handoff" mini-form to RFC: who, when, key context bullets, shadow ack.

rahul: once RFC is up i can prototype the bot change. will also add a lightweight audit event so we can measure reminders fired vs checkpoints posted.

ben: moving to the board this afternoon. will create the "Incident Checkpoints" column and a policy note in the board description.

oncall-bot: note saved to issue tracker (mock): RFC-incident-checkpoints created by jamie.

jamie: done for now, will ping when RFC is ready for review.
